text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um... Maruzen-san!!
Do you have some time tomorrow!?
If you'd like... w-would you play a game together with me!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I'm free, but...
Um, Chiyo-chan, you look a bit pale.
Are you feeling worn out?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's save hanging out for another time, and you should take it easy and rest for now—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No way!! I'm full of energy! Well then, see you tomorrow... I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah... Chiyo-chan! ...I wonder if she'll really be okay...
When I arrived at the meeting spot Sakura Chiyono O invited me to, many Horse Girls were already gathered there. And then—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo-chan, what's all this? There are lots of... slips of paper hanging around.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: It's kind of like... a recreation event to thank you for always looking out for us! Chiyo-chan came up with the idea!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: You aim at the washi paper strings with a water gun and bam! The numbers hanging below them are lottery tickets!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The lottery tickets are set up in all kinds of places! Try to find a bunch and shoot them down!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wait, a thank-you? Recreation? Lottery? Hold on, time out! I have no idea what's going on—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Anyway, won't you give it a try? "Practice makes perfect" for anything!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Eh, whaaat!?
Maruzensky seemed unusually flustered by the sudden turn of events, but caught up in the atmosphere around her, she gradually got into her usual groove—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: I got number 3! Let's see...? Huh, sing your favorite song a cappella!? Th-That's so embarrassing—!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Well then, I'll clap along for you♪ Come on, let's sing it with high spirits and full groove!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Number 9! Ah, I won a juice~! I'm aiming for the next one too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I can't let myself lose either! Mm~! Taking aim... Bam!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yay~! I got number 1! Let's see, what could number 1 be? Fufu, this is so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Number 1 is... the tickle penalty!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What!? No way, after I finally got number 1!? ...Eek~!!
Joyful laughter echoed around. There were no winners or losers; it was clear everyone was simply having pure fun with the game.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'm definitely hitting a winning prize~!
It seemed Sakura Chiyono O's plan was an absolute success.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was so fun! Thanks, Chiyo-chan! But why did you suddenly want to thank me like this?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Because you're always looking out for all of us, Maruzen-san. That's why, once in a while, um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I just wanted you to enjoy yourself to the fullest! It might be a childish idea. But... I...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo-chan... You really thought that much about me. Could that be why you seemed so busy all this time?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, that was just because I was so clumsy at planning it! ...But while running around preparing everything, I had so much fun the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wondering if you'd be pleased, Maruzen-san, and what kind of smile you'd show us... Once I started thinking about it, I just couldn't stop.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So... seeing a smile even brighter than I imagined makes me super happy! Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to see... lots more smiles like today's!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo-chan...! Thank you! You're right, maybe it's okay for me to rely and lean on everyone a bit more!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ! A-Anytime! If you do that... I'd be really happy!
choice_data_list: It was a huge success, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! The target shooting lottery was a huge success... Ah! Look over there. There's still one lottery ticket left... Trainer-san, why don't you take a shot!
In the direction of Sakura Chiyono O's gaze, one ticket remained. Taking aim and shooting it down revealed—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Number 19! The jackpot~! I will carry you home on my back!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my, in that case hold on. I wanted to give thanks too! So instead of Chiyo-chan giving a piggyback ride—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's ride back in my beloved car!! We're gonna burn some serious rubber!!
It was such a wild ride home that I could genuinely feel Maruzensky's joyful excitement the entire way...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's see, that number is... fufu! Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ! Yes, got it! Ufufu...♪ Brace yourself, we're not letting you get away~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Take this—!!
Targeted by Sakura Chiyono O and Maruzensky, I ended up getting soaked from head to toe...
